name: gift-parser
description: Цены подарков Telegram: NestJS + React + WebSocket + PostgreSQL

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run seed && npm run import-session
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it gift_parser_db psql -U gifts -d gifts
